$comment: Copy this file to mcp.json (repo root, or ${OMNI_DATA_DIR:-~/.omni}/mcp.json) to make Omni's Super Agent an MCP host. Each server's tools are exposed to the agent as `<name>__<tool>`. Read-looking tools (get/list/search/read/...) run immediately; everything else is confirm-gated. Restart the API or POST /api/mcp/reload after editing.
